teaser.en: Purple-stained fingers give away anyone who has been eating water berries straight from the tree.
teaser.sw: Vidole vilivyotiwa rangi ya zambarau humwumbua yeyote aliyekuwa akila zambarau moja kwa moja kutoka mtini.
teaser.dg: Vyala vya rangi ya zambarau vinamfitsua chila mutu ariyekala achirya matunda ga *mzambarau* kula muhini.

summary.en: *Mzambarau* is the water berry, a dense, leafy tree of moist and riverside forest with clusters of purple-black fruit. It feeds people, and it is one of the sawn-timber trees Digo carpenters know.
summary.sw: *Mzambarau* (*Syzygium guineense*) ni mti mnene wenye majani mengi wa misitu yenye unyevu na ya kando ya mito, wenye vishada vya matunda ya rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi. Huwalisha watu, na ni mmoja wa miti ya mbao za kupasua inayojulikana na mafundi seremala wa Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Mzambarau* ni *water berry*, muhi wenye makodza manji sana wa matsaka genye chinemi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye mabunda ga matunda ga rangi ya zambarau iriyo phephi na nyiru. Unarisa atu, na ni mwenga wa mihi ya mbao ambayo mafundi a mbao a Chidigo anaimanya.

about.en: *Mzambarau* is a dense, leafy tree with drooping branchlets. Its glossy leaves grow in opposite pairs, and new growth flushes a striking purple-red before turning green. After flowering it carries heavy clusters of small, purple-black berries, like a wild cousin of the Java plum grown in gardens.
about.sw: *Mzambarau* ni mti mnene wenye majani mengi na vitawi vinavyoning'inia. Majani yake yanayong'aa huota kwa jozi zinazokabiliana, na machipukizi mapya hutokea yakiwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu ya kuvutia kabla ya kugeuka kijani. Baada ya kuchanua hubeba vishada vizito vya matunda madogo ya rangi ya zambarau iliyokolea karibu nyeusi, kama binamu wa porini wa mzambarau unaopandwa bustanini (*Syzygium cumini*).
about.dg: *Mzambarau* ni muhi wenye makodza manji sana, na maphungo ganagobeduka photsi. Makodzage ganang'ala na ganamera mairi-mairi, kodza rimwenga chila uphande, na makodza maphya nkutuluka ga rangi ya zambarau na kundu kabla ya kukala ga chijani. Uchimala kutuluza maruwa, unakala na mabunda maziho ga matunda madide ga zambarau iriyo phephi na nyiru, dza ndugu wa weruni wa *mzambarau* (Java plum) unaophandwa midzini.

where.en: It grows in moist forest and along rivers and streams, where its roots can reach water, hence the English name water berry.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu yenye unyevu na kando ya mito na vijito, mahali ambapo mizizi yake inaweza kufikia maji; ndiyo sababu kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *water berry*.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani genye chinemi na kanda-kanda ya miho na miho midide, phatu ambapho miziye inaweza kufikira madzi; kpwa hivyo kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *water berry*.

uses.en: The berries are eaten fresh. The wood is one of the local timber species known to Digo carpenters for sawing into planks, and the tree also gives poles. The bark provides tannin and a dye.
uses.sw: Matunda yake huliwa yakiwa mabichi. Mbao zake ni miongoni mwa aina za mbao za kienyeji zinazojulikana na mafundi seremala wa Kidigo kwa kupasuliwa kuwa mbao, na mti huu pia hutoa nguzo. Gome lake hutoa tanini na rangi.
uses.dg: Matunda nkuriwa dza garivyo. Nyama za muhi ni mwenga wa aina za mbao za hipha zinazomanyikana ni mafundi a mbao a Chidigo kpwa kukereswa kukala mbao, na muhi piya unalavya nguzo. Gopha rinalavya tanini na rangi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mzambarau*, the same as the Swahili; ICRAF's handbook gives *muziahi*. Swahili also has *mzuari*. In English it is the water berry. *Mzambarau* is also the name of the Java plum (*Syzygium cumini*), a close relative.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mzambarau*, sawa na la Kiswahili; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *muziahi*. Kiswahili kina pia *mzuari*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *water berry*. *Mzambarau* pia ni jina la *Java plum* (*Syzygium cumini*), jamaa yake wa karibu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mzambarau*, sawa na ra Chiswahili; chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *muziahi*. Kpwa Chiswahili piya unaihwa *mzuari*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *water berry*. *Mzambarau* piya ni dzina ra *Java plum* (*Syzygium cumini*), ndugu wa phephi.

reason.en: Java plum, same genus and same name
reason.sw: Mzambarau wa bustanini (*Java plum*), jenasi moja na jina lilelile
reason.dg: *Mzambarau* (Java plum), jenasi mwenga na dzina mwenga.

reason.en: Guava, from the same myrtle family
reason.sw: Mpera, wa familia ileile ya mihadasi (*myrtle*)
reason.dg: Mpera, wa jamii mwenga ya myrtle.
Muhi wanjina wa mbao wenye samani.
